title: Onboarding saves 'processing' before its checks run
current: status: processing is saved before eligibility, health and discovery run, so a run killed at 30 s leaves 'processing'.
evidence: Recovery appears to re-run it because nextRunAt is kept, but nothing confirms that no path reads 'processing' as 'creation started'.
investigate: Test: kill after line 764 and before creation; confirm the next run proceeds and doesn't trigger unknown-creation recovery.

criticality.why: Likely self-recovering, but a wrong read could stall or duplicate creation.
